title: Direction of mid-sagittal annulus marker movement under compression, after partial nucleotomy

quantity.name: marker movement direction
quantity.definition: number of hemi-disc specimens whose marker moved posteriorly (P), anteriorly (A) or undetermined (X) under compression; two-tailed sign test p

source.authors: Meakin JR, Redpath TW, Hukins DWL
source.sample: human cadaver lumbar discs bisected mid-sagittally, Thompson grade 2-4; 12 specimens (12 hemi-discs from 6 lumbar discs: L4/L5 x2, L2/L3 x2, L3/L4 x2) for mechanics; 11 whole discs for MRI
source.age: spine C 50 y, spine E 74 y; others unknown

protocol.summary: Mid-sagittally bisected lumbar discs (with vertebral halves) sealed behind a glass window; displacement-controlled compression up to 1.8 mm at 0.2 mm/s (Instron), intact then after partial nucleotomy (mean 0.555 g, SD 0.065 g nucleus removed through the cut face). Seven Alcian blue markers M1 (outer posterior lamella) ... M7 (outer anterior lamella) in the mid-transverse plane; direction of horizontal marker movement (P posterior / A anterior / X undetermined) from video images at start and full (or pre-extrusion) compression. Maximum load: intact 420 N (SD 230), denucleated 270 N (SD 150).
how_to_simulate: Model a hemi-disc (mid-sagittal half) between half-vertebrae with a rigid frictionless window on the cut face; compress axially up to 1.8 mm.
Track horizontal (AP) displacement of 7 equally spaced points across the mid-sagittal annulus/nucleus from posterior (M1) to anterior (M7).
Repeat after removing ~0.55 g nucleus; compare direction of movement (outward/inward) with the majority direction per marker.
protocol.notes: Resection steps in order: (1) intact hemi-disc; (2) partial nucleotomy (marker M3 removed with nucleus). Movement magnitudes 0.005-2.410 mm (mean 0.677, SD 0.528) - not per marker. Catalog DOI 10.1016/S0268-0033(00)00077-2 differs from printed PII S0268-0033(00)00075-9 (used here).

data.note: M1 = outer posterior lamella, M7 = outer anterior lamella
M1 = outer posterior lamella, M7 = outer anterior lamella

extraction.check_notes: All counts and p-values re-read from Table 2. | OK (denucleated rows of Table 2 p.125: all counts and p-values; n=12 hemi-discs from 6 discs)

pass_rule.rule: model marker displacement direction equals the majority direction for every marker with sign-test p<0.05
